release_notes:
Vortex PT 1.3.3 Precision & Maintenance Release:
• Resolved column-beam framing corridor issue where slab tendons passing through column boundaries near framing beams were falsely assigned beam soffit depths, fixing profile spikes (e.g. 700mm) and false cover violation warnings.
• Ensured slab tendons crossing transverse beams strictly preserve slab formwork datum without plunging into beam stems.
• Enhanced tendon ID block attributes and bubble size setting scaling.
